description: Task 3.5: the Logout nav link (GET) became a POST form with CSRF token and button.

Tasks 6.3/6.3b: static/style.css link, confirm-delete.js script and the delete-confirm modal on every page; project delete, spec-item refresh, user/ValSet removal and member add/role controls converted from GET links to POST forms/buttons (same target URL, title and ids are compared, only the control markup is folded); inline onclick confirm removed from the delete link of NEW items; data-confirm-message attributes.

Task 6.6: stored text is HTML-escaped (& < > in text nodes; also " ' in attributes). Applied last and per diff hunk: a hunk is accepted only if html.unescape of the old and new hunk are identical and the new hunk contains an entity whose raw character the old hunk contained. Any other remaining difference makes the page UNEXPLAINED.
Tasks 6.6b/6.6d: backslash, CR, LF, U+2028 and U+2029 are escaped in the link_suggest `linkElements` JS string literals (forms only; not part of the rehearsal snapshot pages).

Task 7.0: import compatibility corpus (tests/test_compat_corpus.py). Any entry (applies_to "html" or "compat") may carry an optional key "compat": {"<corpus input name | *>": ["<table>.<field>" | "<table>.*" | "<table>.#rows" | "_outcome.exception" | "_outcome.message" | "_outcome.messages" | "_outcome.status", ...]} listing the import-fingerprint fields that fix may change (e.g. "editor_projectuser.role"). Entries with applies_to "compat" are ignored by rehearse.py. This entry is documentation only (empty compat); a fix adds its own entry with its own id.

Task 7.4b: the spec-item CSV import ends with ONE summary message ('N imported, M rejected' plus the rejected CSV lines) instead of a success count and an aggregated error count. Only the import message text changes; the imported database rows are identical.
Task 7.4a: the import is one transaction; no corpus input changes because of it alone.

Task 7.4a: a link to a missing or rejected item becomes None and is listed in the import message instead of a KeyError (HTTP 500). zip_owner_not_member_linked: no exception any more, two messages (dropped item, cleared p_link).

Task 7.4a (operator decision 2026-10-24): an item owner who is not a project user is kept and added as a read-only project user if the user exists, otherwise the item goes to the project owner. The dropped item is now imported (item rows shift in the _linked input), the outsider becomes an RO member.
Task 7.4a: ProjectUser.role is read from project_users.csv (RW members stay RW); both inputs now equal the exported roles.
Task 7.4a: Release.application_version is imported; the inputs now equal the exported values (1 / 1 / 2 instead of 0).
Task 7.4a: SpecItem.created_at is imported; in all eight project ZIP inputs it now equals the exported value instead of 2000-01-01.

Task 7.4a: updated_at of Project, Application, ValSet and ProjectUser (auto_now) is restored from the export with queryset.update(); in the inputs it now equals the exported value instead of the import time (the RO member added for an outsider owner keeps the import time).

Task 7.4a: the CSV members are read with newline='' (and utf-8), so CR LF inside a field is kept; the changed fields now equal the exported text (checked for change_log, rationale, remarks, t1; desc differs from the source only by the iref conversion).
Task 7.4a: an application with empty cats imports; zip_app_empty_cats now imports completely (no messages; project, releases, ValSet, application and items created).

Task 7.4a: s_data is stored as the object the export wrote (empty cell -> {}, object text -> object, quoted string stays a string, old double-encoded text -> object); in the inputs '' becomes {} and the two JSON strings become objects.
